LanguageData.FeatherMedals_NoTrophies: This warrior is not yet adorned with any trophies.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CeremonyDesc: Gather the tribe to adorn a warrior with this trophy.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_DisabledAlreadyAwarded: A warrior was already honored with this trophy.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_DisabledRequiresPresenter: Requires a colonist holding one of these roles: {SPEAKERS}.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_DisabledCeremonyInProgress: An adorning ceremony for this trophy is happening right now.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_DisabledNotOnGround: The trophy must be put down before starting an adorning ceremony.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_DisabledCitationLocked: The deeds in the Tale of Honor cannot be changed after the trophy is adorned.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CitationDesc: Write or edit the Tale of Honor about the deeds this trophy represents.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CeremonyAttendance_ToolTip: Up to {QUALITY} of adorning quality. More colonists means a more meaningful adorning.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CeremonyVenue_ToolTip: Up to {QUALITY} of adorning quality. Hold the adorning in an impressive room for a better outcome.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CeremonyCitation_Written_T: {QUALITY} of adorning quality. The Tale of Honor adds weight and meaning to the trophy.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CeremonyCitation_None_Tool: No Tale of Honor written. You will be prompted during the adorning, or write one before the adorning for {QUALITY} bonus to adorning quality.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_CeremonyTrophyQuality_Tool: How much care was put into making and selecting the trophy. A legendary trophy adds up to {MAX} of adorning quality, an awful one takes up to {MIN} away.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Ceremony_Started: {LEADER_labelShort} has begun the adorning ritual of a trophy upon {PAWN_labelShort}.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Ceremony_Failed_TrophyLost: The trophy was lost before {PAWN_labelShort} could be adorned.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_WriteCitationDesc: Tell the Tale of Honor, recount the deeds of a warrior. This tale cannot be changed once the trophy is adorned.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_TakeOfHonorLetterLine1: {PAWN_labelShort} has been ceremonially adorned with a {MEDAL} by {PRESENTER_labelShort}.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_TakeOfHonorLetterLine2: The {QUALITY} adorning ceremony was attended by {ATTENDEES} tribe members, and the deeds of {PAWN_labelShort} have been recognized by the tribe.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_TrophyLocked: This trophy is locked and cannot be removed from the pawn. Click to unlock.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_TrophyUnlocked: This trophy is unlocked and can be removed from the pawn. Click to lock.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_FailTrophyNeedsCeremony: Trophies can only be adorned through ceremonies
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_FailTrophyBiocoded: Trophy belongs to {PAWN_labelShort}, {IMPOSTOR_labelShort} cannot equip it.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_MustHoldSpeakerRole: Must hold one of these roles: {SPEAKERS}.
LanguageData.FeatherTrophy_CannotBeAdornedWith: {PAWN_labelShort} cannot be adorned with this trophy.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_StatDraw_AddTrait_Desc: May grant the {TRAIT} trait when adorned. A ceremony changes at most one trait.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_StatDraw_RemoveTrait_Desc: May remove the {TRAIT} trait when adorned. A ceremony changes at most one trait.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_TrophyRemovedTrait: {PAWN_labelShort} has shed the {TRAIT} trait through this honor.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_TrophyAddedTrait: {PAWN_labelShort} has gained the {TRAIT} trait through this honor.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_LockTrophyUponAwa: If enabled, once a trophy is adorned to a pawn, it will default to being locked on the pawn and cannot be removed. This can be toggled individually on the dedicated tab. This setting does not affect biocoding. Default: ON
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_PromptForCitation: Prompt for a Tale of Honor during Ceremony

If enabled, a dialog will appear during adorning ceremonies to allow the user to enter a Tale of Honor for the trophy if one has not already been added to the trophy. If disabled, a window will not appear, but Tale of Honor can still be added prior to ceremony commencing. Default: ON
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_AutoGenerateCitat: If enabled, when dialog opens to prompt for a Tale of honor and player has not wrote one yet, it will be generated. Default: OFF
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_TrophyDynamicTrai: If enabled, trophies can have a dynamic effect on traits such as gaining an elder trait or losing wimp when receiving bravery awards. A ceremony changes at most one trait.
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_DrawTrophiesOnPaw: If enabled, trophies will be rendered on pawns. Disabling this will stop trophies from being drawn on pawns. Use this to turn their rendering off. Default: ON
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_WornSize_Tooltip: Size of trophy rendered on pawn. Default: 130%
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_VerticalBias_Tool: Controls how much feathers fan out. 0% - straight up, 100% - fanned out. Default: 35%
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_CenterZ_Tooltip: Adjusts to be higher or lower. Default: 0.1
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_DisplayedTrophies: Amount of displayed trophies on pawn. Trophies over this count exist, but are not drawn. Default: 9
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_GenerateNpcTrophi: Pawns from other factions can spawn already adorned with trophies. Existing pawns are not changed. Default: ON
LanguageData.FeatherMedals_Settings_NpcTech_Tooltip: Tech level of factions considered to spawn with trophies. Default: Animal-Medieval
LanguageData.FeatherTrophies_Settings_ShowScalpinGizm: Pawns and corpses will have gizmo that allows player to order them to be scalped by colonists. Scalp action is going to be available when right-clicking pawn or corpse. Default: ON
LanguageData.FeatherTrophies_Settings_ScalpBreaksTarg: Scalping mental breaks can target children
Scalping frenzy and scalping of prisoners mental breaks can target children and babies. Default: OFF
LanguageData.FeatherTrophies_Settings_GenerateScalped: Pawns from other factions can spawn with an old scalping scar. Chance is 5% for animal-level factions and falls linearly to 0% for spacer-level and higher. Default: ON
